name: Swiss / Minimal
thesis: International Typographic Style: a strict modular grid, generous whitespace, flush-left hierarchy, hairline rules, zinc-on-white, mono metadata, and one restrained violet accent — the Fancy kit at its quietest.

tokens.fontDisplay: Inter / Helvetica-class sans, semibold, tight (-0.02em) tracking
tokens.fontMono: mono for labels, numbers, running-heads, metadata
tokens.radius: near-0 — rules and edges, not pills

layout: A strict 12-column modular grid, max-width ~1180px, with generous vertical rhythm. Each section opens with a mono running-head ('NN — LABEL') over a hairline rule. Flush-left typographic hierarchy throughout; the content (type, figures, the work index) carries the page, not chrome.

sections.name: hero
sections.what: A big flush-left statement headline, a short lede, a primary CTA + a jump link, and a mono location/disciplines block at right.
sections.restyle: Buttons flatten to flush rectangles; the right rail is mono metadata; zero decoration.

sections.name: stat-band
sections.what: A 4-up band of big tabular figures (founded / shipped / people / awards) with mono captions.
sections.restyle: Large tabular numerals over mono labels, hairline-separated cells.

sections.name: selected-work
sections.what: A numbered flush-left typographic index of projects (title · discipline · year) with a Pillbox filter and Pagination.
sections.restyle: List rows (not cards), one stretched-link per row, hairline dividers.

sections.name: capabilities
sections.what: Services / process / questions in Tabs, plus a 4-column services grid.
sections.restyle: Tabs as a flush section rail; uppercase mono labels; an accent active-rule.

sections.name: about
sections.what: A large set statement with supporting body copy.
sections.restyle: Oversized statement over a hairline rule.

sections.name: team
sections.what: A row of people with squared avatars and mono roles.
sections.restyle: Squared avatar nameplates; mono role lines.

sections.name: recognition
sections.what: An awards ledger Table plus clients and press columns.
sections.restyle: Table styled as an accountant's ledger — hairlines, mono headers.

sections.name: contact
sections.what: A 'brief the studio' Composer card with Progress and a budget MoodMeter.
sections.restyle: Composer reads as a print-clean brief box; restrained, single-accent controls.

palette.restyle: Flush rectangle — solid violet primary vs hairline-outline ghost; no shadow.
Semibold tight-tracked display + zinc body + mono metadata.
Flush section rail, uppercase mono labels, accent active-rule.
Hairline track with exactly one step tinted violet.

contentArchetype: A creative / design studio one-page portfolio: statement hero, key figures, a selected-work index, capabilities, about, team, recognition, and a 'brief us' contact.
remix: Swiss is the safest base to start from: re-point the semantic tokens to zinc-on-white + one accent, lay a strict 12-column grid with mono running-heads, and let content carry the page. Blend it with another style by keeping this grid + type discipline and borrowing the other style's colour/treatment — e.g. Swiss layout with a Brand-Gradient hero, or Swiss grid with Editorial type and drop caps.
